name: Jem
source:
A popular streamer known for his cosplays. With a little bit of makeup, he can transform himself into almost anybody.

He maintains his cheerful persona off-camera and values the happiness of his friends more than anything else in the world.

Likes: Streaming, cute things
Dislikes: Being useless

"I make costumes for others to use! Sometimes, I stream the creation process and people seem to like watching. I'm just glad I can make others happy."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048330/Mirage_Noir/]Steam[/url]]
